requirements.text: Authenticated feedback stores original-author/private original, closed category, trimmed nonempty description≤5000 and bounded canonical page label with occurrence/idempotency key before outward work. Original-author native listOwn/getOwnStatus uses dedicated25row-cursor DTO and current active account, never admin joins or another author. Stored success is distinct from publication/triage/implementation; suspended/deleted author denied.

Explicit immutable platform-principal grant, separate from plant/org roles, permits bounded private triage filter/list and new/reviewed/resolved/dismissed status changes with expectedrevision/actual actor/history/no-op receipt. Unknown row refuses and stale edit conflicts. Public issue closure remains external observed fact, not proof of implementation/PR/deployment.

Safe automatic feedback issue/triage uses separate PUBLICrepo with private original, frozen sanitized payload/hash/opaque occurrence and durable actual repoID/owner-name snapshot/issueID-number/URL.10second external timeout enters unknown and reconciles same marker in exact destination before retry; inaccessible/ambiguous remains held. Deterministic closed serializer never copies raw private text/IDs/URL/logs, richer publication exact-reviewed; actual merged owner workflow governs routing, no competing rubric/coding authority.

Home routing uses validated current account/seat/active subject and persisted onboarding facts: account-private Discovery/no plant, organization oversight, incomplete setup/resume or plant dashboard. Query parameters/browser dismissals cannot certify setup or bypass server predicates. Creation Phase 1 is independent of Discovery completion.

Plant dashboard retains four independent metrics: recruited core_group/launch_team/leader excluding account-seat cohort; all nondeleted People; viewer-assigned overdue Tasks; completed Vision Meetings. Bounded 20-event feed uses actual source occurrence/correction history and per-item owning read projection. Quick actions require current write capability. Phase header uses actual saved phase; launch card uses canonical planned/status/countdown/readiness and recorded actual outcomes, without treating UI counters as rubric thresholds. Scoped dismissal state can hide optional prompts, never change evidence. No plant-private activity feed is an oversight substitute.

behavior_rules.rule: Visible information for plant_member: namedCohortMetrics, datedActivity, safeAttribution, sourceReferences, completeness, nextCursor.
Visible information for plant_member: accountKind, exactContext, safeDestination, setupGaps, currentlyAllowedActions.

requirements.text: Public landing/examples are static synthetic illustrations with claims matching actual target. Invitation request validates normalized email and honeypot; it neither registers nor creates CRM/lead rows. Durable limited purpose-mail intent dedupes normalized email for a 24-hour window; bounded server rate limit 5 requests/address/day plus 20 trusted-IP requests/hour and global provider budget. Honeypot gets fake success; missing recipient/provider error gives contact fallback, not claimed invitation. No newsletter/double-opt-in/lead-management scope.

behavior_rules.rule: Email-only approved public request, trusted native rate proof/server budget context; normalized-address24h dedup/5day/20IPhour limits, honeypot fake success, no CRM/account/lead row or arbitrary spam-proof field.

requirements.text: Public privacy/terms and static sitemap/robots preserve public access; robots is not auth. Before real data, reviewed copy names actual selected vendors, model purpose/terms, immediate normal-access suspension, 30-day private cancellation hold, eligible live purge, ≤7 further days of recovery copies from completed live purge, minimal retained shared attribution and asynchronous/external-copy limits. Disclose shared Tigris provider/account backup risk and no customer recovery SLA. Avoid exact day-37 physical erasure or recalled public/mail/download claims.

Automatic public feedback serializer outputs only closed category/allowlisted public area/fixed product-summary wording/opaque random occurrence marker. Private original and actual immutable repo+issue locator are separate. Unknown unsafe fields hold; no raw original/title/URL/IDs/names/logs/attachments fallback. Richer exact payload requires authorized publication review; merged workflow handoff governs private triage/routing without granting coding authority.

A safe sanitized product summary creates/triages an issue automatically in the separate public feedback repository. Preserve the private original and store actual repository identity plus issue number/link/outcome; changing global repo configuration cannot rewrite historical issue links.

behavior_rules.rule: Revisioned exact triage status/no-op/correction with actor/time; external issue close does not mean implemented/resolved/deployed.
Supported toStatus values: new, reviewed, resolved, dismissed.
Visible information for explicit_platform_administrator: items, nextCursor, privateOriginal, privateOpaqueLocator, triageStatus, publishStatus.
Authorized native private original triage
Visible information for explicit_platform_administrator: items, nextCursor, safePublicSummary, category, triageStatus, publishStatus.
Closed safe public summary/status only; opaque original resolution separately requires actual merged workflow native/private purpose
Feedback category filters accept only bug, suggestion, question and other.

Server deterministic serializer uses category+allowlisted area+fixed text+opaque marker only and frozen actual PUBLIC repo ID/destination; no caller-submitted safe text/hash privacy proof. Normal safe auto create; unsafe/unknown holds without raw fallback;10sec timeout.
Supported state_contract values: pending, held, publishing, published, rejected, unknown.
Exact trusted-original-author feedback status, no nullable missing ID/page args or private originals/admin joins/contact/plant IDs/routing.
Native own bounded25 status page; original author current active account, no raw original or other author existence.
Configured actual authorized operator and safe frozen content only, same email_intent ledger; no raw private original/token/contact body in general notification, unknown mail remains truthful.

Actual exact frozen repo+opaque marker reconciliation records observed issue locator; caller cannot assert created/absent or override repo. Inaccessible/ambiguous search stays unknown; duplicate candidates held for review, no blind create.

Closed authenticated intake stores private original and trusted author; subject optional, page canonicalized to approved internal route stripping query/fragment. Stored success distinct from public publication/implementation.
Supported category values: bug, suggestion, question, other.

Bound registered safe category-label initial triage or owner-provided merged workflow version; no caller arbitrary labels/status, competing complexity rubric or coding/merge/deploy authority. Actual receipts never claim implementation.

Pure trusted authorization guard evaluates actual fresh authenticated immutable-principal explicit platform grant; registered system job alone never becomes human platform admin. Does not mint grant/mutate/audit-success.
Actual active authenticated immutable principal with explicit current platform grant; no model-supplied principal or operator scope.
Stored explicit platform permission, owning exact-purpose operation predicate.

requirements.text: Native listOwn/getOwnStatus uses authenticated original-account identity and a bounded original-author DTO. Guessing another feedbackID gives no private access; admin joins returning contact/church details are not reused and no public roadmap/status page is implied.

Public title/body contains no raw private description or church/user IDs, names/contact details, church records, screenshots/logs or pageURL query tokens. Explicitly reviewed publication of an otherwise withheld item has exact authorized payload/audience provenance; no blanket consent or attachment feature.

When safe public summary cannot be established, retain private intake and truthful pending/held status, withhold unsafe bytes and avoid a blind raw-text fallback. This does not make normal safe publication manually gated or select a model/classifier threshold.

Failure/unknown issue creation retains immutable intended payload/correlation and actual destination/receipt; reconcile before a new issue, without duplicate publication. Show actual native/publication/triage status; issue closure alone does not prove implementation, merged PR or deployment.

Reviewed Evry feedback submission shares native domain intake and original-author scope. Named automatic intake/triage does not grant general conversational durable-write autonomy or coding authority. Await owner merged workflow; no competing rubric, repo creation or required public roadmap.

Preserve durable native private feedback/triage and configured safe operator mail. Automatically create safe sanitized issue in a separate PUBLICfeedback repository, persisting actual destination/locator/receipt and truthful failure/unknown. Actual repository identity/configuration still future input, not a visibility choice or rawpublication grant.

Automatictriage uses safe minimal report and only the actual merged owner development workflow/version for severity/complexity/escalation. Missinghand-off remains explicit; no invented competing rubric or automaticimplementation class.

Implementation/PRrouting waits for the actual merged authoritative owner workflow/version. Humanreview and explicit escalation remain; no automaticmerge/deploy or unspecifiedworktree inspection/merge.

Use only necessary sanitized issue/triage data with the selected destination permission/disclosure. Treat feedback as untrusted content, not commands/authority for agents or exfiltration. Preserve scoped records and failure/retry correlation without duplicate issues. The named intake/triage automation is not a blanket exception to exactly reviewed conversational Evry durable writes or private-care exclusions.

One authenticated bounded Next/Postgres executor, durable owed work, fairness/lease/fencing/lag/recovery catalog in execution. Triggers contain no business authority. Actual schedule/account tier is configuration proof, not inferred from free development.

Public liveness returns only bounded process status/time. Privileged readiness distinguishes DB/object/mail/callback backlog/job lag/reference/backup readiness with safe error correlation. Dependency failure cannot be a fake empty result. No sensitive details/token/address/body in public error or health.

behavior_rules.rule: Pure existing content-free correlation query, no new business mutation or sensitive error/raw stack/body/credential leak.
Public liveness process/time only; no operator scope, DB credentials, tenant evidence or sensitive dependency detail.

Privileged content-free readiness distinguishes actual unavailable dependency/backlog/reference/backup proof; checks read only actual current configuration, never fake empty readiness or claim unconfigured host selected.

requirements.text: Optional configured Sentry and isolated Langfuse/OTel retain content-free latency/token/status/build/run correlation. Validate explicit HTTPS endpoint except loopback, no embedded credentials/query/hash/public secrets; no implicit tracing-provider fallback. Bounded flush/telemetry outage cannot change domain result. Private-care body/existence/calendar/nudge metadata, credentials/mail body/addresses/model prompts/file bytes are excluded.

behavior_rules.rule: Advisory bounded content-free telemetry sink only; omit prompts/body/bytes/credentials/email/address/private-care existence/calendar/nudge metadata. Sink/flush failure cannot roll back or alter business result; no mandatory domain mutation audit.
Best-effort bounded configured content-free sink; failure is isolated from owning domain transaction/result. No business CommandReceipt/history requirement.

requirements.text: Required cross-domain consequences use one short owning transaction; attendance/obligation/task/audit/receipt consistency is not in-memory event delivery. Advisory named effects get durable outbox/job intent and idempotent consumer. Each consumer rechecks subject/scope. No public arbitrary-event RPC or universal workflow engine.

behavior_rules.rule: Registered owning domain/consumer only; actual transaction UnitOfWork/source mutation is trusted context, all mandatory source/parent fields. Required cross-domain consequences same short transaction; advisory outbox follows persisted source, never public arbitrary event RPC.

requirements.text: Fresh versioned migration history/checksums and approved reference bootstrap; positively identified owned DB target, advisory lock and replay provenance. Preserve applied history and refuse conflicting checksum/unknown target. No db:push, legacy-chain requirement, live ledger patching or customer migration. Recovery uses recovery.

Separate immutable approved references from synthetic demo/evaluation fixtures. Seed/reset only explicitly positively identified disposable owned environment with independent DB/storage/auth/mail/jobs and no copied production identities/credentials. Sentinel alone is insufficient. Repeat-equal bootstrap no-op and mismatches stop.

Hermetic build with frozen lockfile and placeholder secrets; meaningful contract/browser/API/native SQL race/failure suites require explicit isolated endpoint and registered real execution. Mock counts/text checks cannot certify behavioral acceptance. Before real data close actual DB+matching-byte restore and retention/expiry proof.

Named managed preview records checkout/source revision/URL and isolated DB/storage/auth/provider destinations; no unrelated localhost evidence, dependency symlink or secret wholesale copy. Real mail/model/provider actions are disabled/stubbed unless separately authorized. Cleanup is scoped to that verified preview.

Requirement/case/issue traceability and optional engineering board integration only after merged owner workflow is received. Do not copy historical hardcoded private project/options/tokens or revive retired delivery gates. Live labels/status reread; missing integration visibly skips without product failure. Safe public intake/triage remains the accepted subset and does not wait for invented routing.

Read-only tool/script inventory classifies diagnostic versus mutation, identifies target/credentials/environment and records named native proof coverage. Hooks/proof tools are installed only for chosen supported workflow. Preserve semantic tests/reproducibility rather than every historic adapter. Inventory is not permission to execute a script.

Read-only source/retired-Evry diagnostics remain evidence. The new first-class Evry contract uses shared target domain operations; no legacy runtime/table restoration or assumption from a catalog probe. Existing v2 source/database remains untouched.

behavior_rules.rule: Read-only positively identified source/retired runtime diagnostic; no legacy DB mutation/restoration, credential extraction or runtime proof claim.
